searchText: Hey everyone, I'm part of the Ethereum Protocol Fellowship and planning to research Single Slot Finality for both that and my Master's thesis. Is there anyone who's been working on it who has suggestions on what I should explore or questions I should attempt to answer? Or has suggestions for who I should reach out to? Last literature I've seen are this notes from Vitalik, https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/single_slot_finality <@862973562243252234> proposed Horn on Nov'22 which is related to SSF https://ethresear.ch/t/horn-collecting-signatures-for-faster-finality/14219 and still a relevant research path <@520034910149410861> expressed the dependency of SSF for ePBS which might have bumped the current time investment on the topic, he might know more Thank you! Will look into those resources
